scripts.last-failed: powershell -Command "if (Select-String -Path 'test-results/.last-run.json' -Pattern '\"failedTests\":\s*\[\s*\]' -Quiet) { Write-Host 'No failed test(s) found! Skipping execution.' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host 'Failures detected. Rerunning failed test(s)...' -ForegroundColor Yellow; npx playwright test --last-failed }"
